criteriaSatisfied.evidence: Concrete findings with file paths, line numbers, and severities delivered: 4 blockers (Layout.astro:77/86/95 mobile nav collapse; global.css:576 broken hotspot frame via unlayered CSS overriding Tailwind utilities; global.css:500/522-523 invisible hotspot tooltip/label in 5 dark themes; Layout.astro:57 skip-link dead on 4/5 pages), 11 high/medium issues, and 9 low issues, each with a concrete fix.

validationOutput: Static source review of src/layouts/Layout.astro, src/styles/global.css, all 5 pages under src/pages/[lang]/, src/components/HotspotImage.astro, src/components/BeforeAfterSlider.astro, src/i18n/content.ts, src/i18n/ui.ts, astro.config.mjs, PRODUCT.md; grep-verified dead keys, dead CSS/JS, and token usage.
residualRisks: Images could not be viewed in this session (model has no image support); cropping quality of the object-cover frames and hotspot position need a human eye pass.
No interactive run: lightbox, hotspot, slider, and the 8-theme switcher were verified from code only; needs click-through in 2 languages x 8 themes, especially the two dark-theme contrast bugs.
Theme system is a live QA liability: at least one component (hotspot cards/labels) is broken on 5 of 8 themes and pulse-ring variants are missing for is/mose; more breakages are likely.
Suggested commands for the supervisor: bun run build and bun run astro check (not run; review was read-only).

reviewFindings: blocker: Layout.astro:77/86/95 - nav links hidden below sm with no mobile menu or footer page links; Plans page unreachable on mobile and only reachable via header on desktop

blocker: global.css:576 - .hotspot-image {border-radius:inherit;overflow:visible} unlayered overrides Tailwind's rounded-2xl overflow-hidden utilities; ourlady main image renders square-cornered and hotspot rings/tooltips bleed past the frame

blocker: global.css:522-523 + 500 - hotspot card/label use on-surface (light in dark themes) with theme-invariant light inverse-on-surface / hardcoded warm-white bg; tooltip text invisible on natt/kull/solnedgang/aurora
blocker: Layout.astro:57 - skip link targets #main-content, which only exists on index.astro:29; broken on story/plans/ourlady/support

high: Layout.astro:64 + 103/108 - logo links to base root which redirects to /no, dropping English users onto the Norwegian home; language switcher always returns to home instead of translating the current page
high: global.css:88-260 - 8 themes each redefine brand hues; electric themes fight warm chapel photography; is/mose missing pulse-ring variants; theme system is a brand multiplier and QA sink
high: index.astro:40 vs story.astro:30/plans.astro:52 - interior H1s (md:text-7xl) larger than home hero (md:text-6xl); three H1 sizes across four pages

high: index.astro:66-105 - gallery section unlabeled photo dump; dead whatHeading (content.ts:11) and dead close-end-card keys (content.ts:27-29); bare square-cornered bottom bleed (index.astro:150-157) breaks the rounded photo system

medium: Layout.astro:67-116 - arbitrary font-['Newsreader']/['Plus_Jakarta_Sans']/['Epilogue'] without fallbacks vs token fonts on pages; Support pill set in Newsreader italic while identical CTAs elsewhere are Epilogue labels
medium: index.astro:51-63 - secondary Instagram link (text-lg Newsreader italic) typographically louder than primary map CTA (text-sm Epilogue button)
medium: Layout.astro:313 - footer copyright text-xs at 60% on-surface-variant ~3.0:1 contrast, fails WCAG AA
medium: plans.astro:157-190 - lightbox has no focus trap, no focus return, hover-only zoom affordance, alt-duplicating captions
medium: BeforeAfterSlider.astro:65-66 - hardcoded #36557b handle arrows clash with copper/orange themes; slider semantics attached only via JS

low: Layout.astro:28-38 - 700-word THESIS comment shipped in every page; dead CSS (btn-pulse, timeline-line, progress-bar-fill, reveal-delay-*, btn-touch); empty Welcome.astro; DESIGN.md promised but missing
low: global.css:332-336 - reveal starts opacity:0 with no no-JS fallback; story/plans headers permanently invisible without JS
low: Layout.astro:24 - viewport lacks initial-scale=1; identical titles on all pages; no theme-color; no color-scheme sync for dark themes
low: support.astro:63-85 - donor grid lopsided when recent activity is empty; plans.astro:113-119 - 5 sketches in 3-col grid = ragged rows at natural aspect
